title: How to Source Custom Rugs from India: A Step-by-Step Guide
summary: A practical guide for architects, designers and trade buyers on sourcing made-to-order carpets and rugs from India — from design brief and sampling to production and dispatch.

seo.title: How to Source Custom Rugs from India | Buying Guide — TAPIS GLOBAL
seo.description: A step-by-step buying guide to sourcing custom, made-to-order carpets and rugs from India: brief, materials, construction, sampling, production timeline and dispatch. From TAPIS GLOBAL, Bhadohi.

body.body: The clearest quotations come from a clear brief. Useful details include project type, buyer type, approximate size and quantity, preferred material and construction, colours and pattern, timeline and destination. TAPIS GLOBAL manufactures to order in Bhadohi — nothing is ready-stock — so the specification drives everything.

The fibre sets the look and feel; the construction (hand-knotted, hand-tufted, handloom, flatweave and others) sets the detail and finish. The team can recommend combinations commonly considered for your setting and confirm suitability for your project.
Custom colours and designs are developed to your brief and confirmed with samples and a colour sample (lab-dip) before bulk production, so what you approve is what is produced.

Typical made-to-order production and dispatch is approximately 3–4 weeks, subject to specifications and quantity. Export orders are prepared with the relevant documentation. Exact timelines are confirmed at the quotation stage.

faq.a: No — every carpet and rug is manufactured to order to your design, size, colours, material, construction and quantity.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and pricing?
faq.a: These depend on the specification. The TAPIS GLOBAL team can confirm the latest information and prepare a quotation for your project.
